changelog: - **Resting the mouse on a node shows what it connects to.** On a computer, keep the pointer on a node for a moment and that node, its connections and the nodes at their other ends are ringed and outlined in amber — one step out, no further — and the mark goes the moment the pointer leaves. Moving to a node with the keyboard shows the same at once. The rest of the canvas is not dimmed, and nothing is selected or changed: the Inspector, the document and Undo stay as they were. Each line keeps its own colour, dash and arrow, so its kind and direction still read; in high-contrast mode the mark is a double ring, dashed rings and heavier lines. It is off while Focus is on, while you drag a node or draw a connection, and on touch screens, where a tap still selects.
